questions.question: What does a translation do to a figure?
choices: Turns it around a fixed point
Moves every point by the same vector
Multiplies every length by a scale factor

questions.question: What does a reflection do?
choices: Maps points across a line at equal perpendicular distances

questions.question: What describes a rotation?
choices: A turn around a fixed center
A slide by a fixed vector

questions.question: Reflect (3, −2) across the x-axis. What is its image?

What is a line of symmetry?
choices: A line across which reflection maps a figure onto itself
A line that divides a figure into equal areas only

questions.question: Why does a scalene triangle have no line of symmetry?
choices: Every triangle has three symmetry lines
A triangle must have a right angle to be symmetric
No reflection line matches its unequal sides and vertices

choices: It doubles distances between distinct points

At twice its original distance from the axis
